title: COMPUTATIONAL STUDIES OF CARGO TRANSPORT THROUGH THE NUCLEAR PORE COMPLEX
authors: Gautam SK; Laghaei R; Nasrabad AE; Coalson RD
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化MD模拟研究核孔复合物中无序核孔蛋白(Nups)介导的转运受体(Kaps/NTF2)互作与运输机制，对象为IDP、聚焦PPI介导的运输机制，方法为物理模拟，虽非相分离但机制建模高度相关。
abstract: Nuclear Pore Complexes (NPCs) are large protein complexes in eukaryotic cells that span the double-membrane of the nucleus and regulate bi-directional transport between nucleus and cytoplasm. T h e NPC core is lined by intrinsically disordered protein chains called nucleoporins (Nups) which form a selective barrier where large macromolecules (cargoes) need to bind to nuclear transport receptors (NTRs) such as Karyopherins (Kaps) to cross. Previous experimental results have suggested that not only Nups but Kaps, too, are important in the transport process of other NTRs/NTR-cargo complexes. In this work, we assess the role of Kaps in the transport of other NTRs (specifically, NTF2s) through the NPC, a process referred to as the “Kap-centric transport model”. Here, using coarse-grained MD simulation we show that Kaps are able to direct NTF2s into the Nup meshwork, which leads to their increased flow. Our results also suggest that NTRs follow specific lanes inside the pore to maximize efficient transport.
abstract_zh: 核孔复合体（NPCs）是真核细胞中的大型蛋白质复合体，跨越细胞核的双层膜，调控细胞核与细胞质之间的双向运输。NPC核心由称为核孔蛋白（Nups）的内在无序蛋白质链排列而成，这些链形成选择性屏障，其中大型大分子（货物）需与核运输受体（NTRs）如核转运蛋白（Kaps）结合才能穿越。先前的实验结果表明，不仅Nups，Kaps在其他NTRs/NTR-货物复合物的运输过程中也至关重要。在本研究中，我们评估了Kaps在通过NPC运输其他NTRs（具体为NTF2s）过程中的作用，这一过程被称为“Kap中心运输模型”。在此，我们利用粗粒化分子动力学（MD）模拟显示，Kaps能够引导NTF2s进入Nup网状结构，从而增加其流动。我们的结果还表明，NTRs在孔内遵循特定通道以最大化高效运输。
